full_text_en:
Xinda Freight Stowage Business Department v. China Agricultural Machinery Southwest Company — Dispute over Transportation Contract

Plaintiff: Xinda Freight Stowage Business Department of Qingyang District, Chengdu, Sichuan Province.
Legal Representative: Zhao Zhigao, Manager.
Agent ad litem: Li Junzhang, lawyer of Zhongchuan Dazhong Law Firm.

Defendant: China Agricultural Machinery Southwest Company.
Legal Representative: Wang Jianshe, Manager.
Agent ad litem: Xiao Shuai and Bai Shuping, employees of the Company.

Third Party: Liu Longsheng, male, born on May 8, 1964, a resident of Chengdu, Sichuan Province.

The Plaintiff, Xinda Freight Stowage Business Department of Qingyang District, Chengdu, Sichuan Province (hereinafter referred to as Xinda Freight Department), filed a lawsuit with the Qingyang District People's Court of Chengdu, Sichuan Province, against the Defendant, China Agricultural Machinery Southwest Company (hereinafter referred to as Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company), and the Third Party, Liu Longsheng, regarding a dispute over a transportation contract.

The Plaintiff alleged: The Plaintiff, as the consignor, entered into a highway transportation contract with the Defendant, Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company. Although the contract was not affixed with the official seal of the Defendant, the vehicle designated for use in the contract belonged to the Defendant, and the documents presented by the carrier, Liu Longsheng, et al., were also those of the Defendant. Therefore, the Defendant, as the owner of the vehicle, should bear full responsibility for the performance of the contract. During the performance of the contract, a traffic accident occurred involving the Defendant's vehicle, causing a total loss of RMB 21,810 to the Plaintiff's cargo. The Plaintiff requested the court to order the Defendant to compensate for the cargo loss and interest.

The Defendant argued: The vehicle that transported the Plaintiff's cargo was a vehicle sold by our company to Liu Longsheng on an installment basis. To prevent the buyer from selling or transferring the vehicle before paying off the full purchase price, the vehicle's registration is currently temporarily held in our company's name. The contract in question was signed by Liu Longsheng and the Plaintiff. Our company neither affixed its official seal to this contract nor ratified it afterwards. Therefore, there is no contractual relationship with the Plaintiff, and all rights and obligations arising from this contract are unrelated to our company and should be borne by Liu Longsheng. The court should dismiss the Plaintiff's claims.

The Third Party, Liu Longsheng, did not file a defense.

The Qingyang District People's Court of Chengdu, after trial, found the following facts: On April 18, 1998, Liu Fangyun, a representative of the Plaintiff Xinda Freight Department, and Fu Weihua, the driver of the Defendant's vehicle with license plate Chuan A16426 (Sichuan A16426), signed a "Sichuan Province Highway Cargo Transport Contract" in Shanghai. The contract stipulated that Vehicle Chuan A16426 would transport shoe soles, spark plugs, freezers, and other goods for Xinda Freight Department from Shanghai, Zhejiang and other places, with the destination being Chengdu. The contract also included provisions on freight charges, transportation time, etc. After the contract was signed, Vehicle Chuan A16426 was involved in a traffic accident during transit, causing losses to the spark plugs consigned by Xinda Freight Department totaling RMB 14,680, and losses to the plywood totaling RMB 7,122 (including RMB 5,386.5 for lost plywood), with total cargo losses amounting to RMB 21,810. Subsequently, after unsuccessful negotiations with Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company regarding compensation for the cargo losses, Xinda Freight Department filed this lawsuit. During the trial, Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company submitted an installment vehicle purchase contract it had signed with Liu Longsheng. In addition to specifying the vehicle price, installment payment schedule and amounts, the contract also stipulated: Liu Longsheng shall be provided by Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company with all relevant procedures, including the vehicle's operation permit, for cargo transportation; during the payment period, if any accident caused by Party B (Liu Longsheng) results in personal injury or property damage to a third party, Party B shall bear full responsibility.

The above facts are confirmed by the transportation contract, the vehicle license of Chuan A16426 belonging to Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company, the list of cargo losses, the installment vehicle purchase contract, and the statements of the parties.

The Qingyang District People's Court of Chengdu held that the transportation contract signed by the Third Party, Liu Longsheng and Fu Weihua, with the Plaintiff Xinda Freight Department, using the Defendant Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company's transport vehicle, vehicle license, and operation procedures, should be recognized as a business activity of Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company. This transportation contract was lawfully established and, pursuant to Article 6 of the Economic Contract Law of the People's Republic of China, should be protected by law. The parties must fully perform the obligations stipulated in the contract, and neither party may unilaterally alter or rescind the contract. Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company's defense that Liu Longsheng's transportation activities were not part of the vehicle owner's work tasks was untenable. Pursuant to Article 36, Item 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Economic Contract Law, the cargo losses caused by the traffic accident during the performance of the transportation contract should be borne by the vehicle owner, Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company, for compensation. Given that the vehicle purchase contract contained a provision that during the payment period, Liu Longsheng shall bear full responsibility for personal injury or property damage caused to third parties by accidents, Liu Longsheng is liable for compensation for the cargo losses in this case. Accordingly, the Qingyang District People's Court of Chengdu rendered the following judgment on October 16, 1998:

Liu Longsheng shall, within ten days from the date this judgment takes legal effect, compensate Xinda Freight Stowage Business Department of Qingyang District, Chengdu, for cargo losses of RMB 21,810, plus interest from May 19, 1998, until the date of full payment, calculated at the contemporaneous loan interest rate of the People's Bank of China. If payment is not made within the specified time limit, China Agricultural Machinery Southwest Company shall bear the liability for satisfaction.

Court acceptance fee of RMB 880 and other litigation costs of RMB 710, totaling RMB 1,590, shall be borne equally by Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company and Liu Longsheng, each paying RMB 795.

The Defendant, Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company, dissatisfied with the judgment of first instance, appealed to the Chengdu Intermediate People's Court. Its grounds for appeal were: The transportation contract is unrelated to our company. Moreover, our company had already agreed with Liu Longsheng in the vehicle purchase contract that if a traffic accident occurring before the vehicle's transfer of registration caused losses to a third party, Liu Longsheng should bear full responsibility. Even if the court holds our company liable, our company should only bear responsibility for direct losses caused by the traffic accident, and not for cargo lost after the accident.

Xinda Freight Department responded: The sale of a motor vehicle is a formal legal act. If the vehicle is not transferred in registration, the sale is invalid. Liability for damage caused to a third party by a traffic accident involving such a vehicle should be borne by the lawful vehicle owner. Therefore, the original judgment was correct and should be upheld.

The Chengdu Intermediate People's Court, after trial, confirmed the facts found in the first instance and additionally found: On April 18, 1998, Liu Longsheng and Fu Weihua, the driver of Vehicle Chuan A16426, went together to the Shanghai office of Xinda Freight Department. After Liu Longsheng and Fu Weihua presented their personal ID cards and the vehicle license for Chuan A16426, Fu Weihua, in the name of Sichuan Agricultural Machinery Company, signed an "Sichuan Province Highway Cargo Transport Contract" with Liu Fangyun, the representative of the appellee Xinda Freight Department, in Shanghai. The contract was not affixed with the official seal of Sichuan Agricultural Machinery Company. In the installment vehicle purchase contract signed between the appellant Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company and Liu Longsheng, it was agreed that during the installment payment period, the vehicle's registration would be affiliated with Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company as collateral. If a traffic accident during this period caused personal injury or property damage to a third party, Liu Longsheng would be responsible. After the contract was signed, Liu Longsheng paid part of the vehicle price, and Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company delivered Vehicle Chuan A16426 and relevant documents to Liu Longsheng. Among the documents Liu Longsheng and Fu Weihua presented to Xinda Freight Department, the vehicle license for Chuan A16426 was provided by Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company. After Liu Longsheng put Vehicle Chuan A16426 into operation, all operating income belonged to him personally.

The Chengdu Intermediate People's Court held:

The first instance court correctly determined the cause of action as a dispute over a transportation contract. Generally, the parties to a transportation contract are only the carrier and the consignor. Whether the carrier uses its own transport tools or leased or borrowed tools to perform the carrier's obligations stipulated in the transportation contract does not affect the establishment of the transportation contract. Therefore, the appellant Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company in this case is unrelated to the transportation contract and should not be a party to it. When the Third Party Liu Longsheng and the driver of Vehicle Chuan A16426, Fu Weihua, signed the transportation contract with the appellee Xinda Freight Department, apart from holding their personal ID cards, driver's licenses, and the vehicle license for Chuan A16426, they failed to produce any valid documents proving their authority to sign a transportation contract on behalf of Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company. Moreover, Liu Longsheng and Fu Weihua signed the transportation contract in the name of Sichuan Agricultural Machinery Company, not Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company, and their conduct did not meet any of the constituent elements of apparent agency for Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company. Xinda Freight Department, as an organization specializing in consignment business, should have examined the carrier with whom it signed the transportation contract, particularly individuals who signed contracts in the name of an entity but did not hold valid authorization documents from that entity. Xinda Freight Department had a higher duty of discernment. Xinda Freight Department had no reason to believe that Liu Longsheng and Fu Weihua were fully authorized representatives of Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company. Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company is unrelated to the transportation contract in this case and should bear no liability for the transportation activities of Liu Longsheng and Fu Weihua in this case. Whether Liu Longsheng had fully paid the vehicle purchase price after signing the installment vehicle purchase contract with Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company, whether the vehicle had undergone registration transfer procedures with the administrative authority, who was recorded as the vehicle owner on the vehicle license, and whether the sold vehicle had been delivered to Liu Longsheng's possession and use as agreed are all matters of another legal relationship and irrelevant to this case. Moreover, the vehicle purchase contract had already stipulated that after the vehicle was delivered to Liu Longsheng's control and use, the risk liability should be borne by Liu Longsheng. The first instance court erred in identifying Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company as a party to this case based on grounds such as that the vehicle had not been transferred in registration, that Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company was the actual owner of Vehicle Chuan A16426, and that the transportation contract signed by Liu Longsheng and Fu Weihua with Xinda Freight Department using Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company's transport vehicle and vehicle license constituted Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company's business activities. This error should be corrected.

The transportation contract in this case was signed by the Third Party Liu Longsheng and the appellee Xinda Freight Department. Liu Longsheng is the actual carrier party, and Xinda Freight Department is the consignor party. During the performance of the transportation contract, the cargo losses caused by the traffic accident should be compensated by the actual carrier, Liu Longsheng. The appeal grounds of the appellant Southwest Agricultural Machinery Company are valid and should be sustained. The original judgment had unclear findings on some facts and improper application of law, and should be modified. Accordingly, pursuant to Article 153, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Chengdu Intermediate People's Court rendered the following final judgment on March 9, 1999:

1. The content of the first instance judgment stating "Liu Longsheng shall, within ten days from the date this judgment takes legal effect, compensate Xinda Freight Stowage Business Department of Qingyang District, Chengdu, for cargo losses of RMB 21,810, plus interest from May 19, 1998, until the date of full payment, calculated at the contemporaneous loan interest rate of the People's Bank of China" is affirmed.

2. The content of the first instance judgment stating "If payment is not made within the specified time limit, China Agricultural Machinery Southwest Company shall bear the liability for satisfaction" is reversed.

The court acceptance fee of RMB 880 for the second instance shall be borne by Xinda Freight Department. The court acceptance fee of RMB 880 for the first instance shall be borne by Liu Longsheng.
